  "title": "Risks and assumptions",
  "text": "The main risks include the proposal exceeding 20 pages or missing the 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC deadline, integration or testing delays pushing deployment past spring enrollment, and users needing historical signed records trapped in the legacy tool before migration completes [RSK-001, RSK-002, RSK-003]. To mitigate these, we would enforce an 18-page budget, perform a dry-run upload one week early, pre-build the REST API connector, establish a manual fallback, accelerate migration to finish before the 2027-01-11 go-live date, and provide read-only legacy access [RSK-001, RSK-002, RSK-003]. Open questions remain regarding the twelve most used forms, migration data structure and volume by 2027-02-28, optional on-premises pricing and infrastructure, severity-one incident ticketing channels, the REST API schema and rate limit, and contract award timing relative to the go-live date [Q-01, Q-02, Q-03, Q-04, Q-05, Q-06].",
